text:
Ava (PM): quick sync — we need to lock sequencing for the Q3 launch. main asks: perf SLOs, dedicated capacity plan, security sign-off, and rollback policy. Can each lead confirm blockers + rough ETA? :eyes:

Ravi (Eng): we hit p95 latency on small tests. to hit <200ms we need batching + prefix cache ops. depends on Marta's kernel change + infra staging GPUs. estimate 2 sprints for tuning. :+1:

Marta (Runtime): kernel patch is in review (PR #423). if it lands this week I can run perf runs. ETA 4 business days for merge + perf run. also need a stable quantization profile for the canary.

Liam (Infra): we can provision 2x a100s in staging next Tues. for prod Dedicated pool we need a capacity commit — procurement + quota lead time ~3 weeks. for canary we can use burst nodes but not steady state.

Priya (Security): need updated data flow diagram (only request: what metadata is logged). also require KMS review and an abbreviated threat model before prod. can do sign-off after 2-day threat session. share diagrams here or link to confluence.

Noah (EM): thanks — specific ask: what's the minimum runway to go from staging canary -> prod? we need to tell stakeholders dates.

Ravi (Eng): staging canary -> prod if all tests pass: ~5 business days after perf sign-off. that's optimistic (assumes infra reservation).

Jules (Solutions): customer asks: allow pinning of model variants during rollout. please add as non-blocking requirement for GA but mandatory for early customers.

Marta (Runtime): noted. runtime can expose a rollout flag for variants. needs one small API tweak.

Ava (PM): ok summarizing: - Kernel PR merge (Marta) - Staging GPUs (Liam) - Batching + cache tuning (Ravi) - Threat model + KMS review (Priya) - Canary rollout policy + model-pin flag (Marta/Jules)

Ava (PM): can each lead reply here with a short line: "OK / Blocked / Need X days" so I can publish a schedule by EOD.

Ravi (Eng): OK, need 10 working days for tuning + perf runs. blocked until kernel PR merged.

Marta (Runtime): OK, 4 business days to merge + perf runs. no other blockers.

Liam (Infra): Need procurement sign-off for Dedicated (Need 15 business days). staging GPU for canary: OK next Tue.

Priya (Security): Need 3 business days after diagrams are posted. blocked until diagram + log spec.

Jules (Solutions): OK, model-pin flag is small, 3 business days to implement and test.

Noah (EM): summarizing constraints -> earliest optimistic schedule: ~3 weeks if procurement slides in, otherwise can do a soft launch to customers on staging + dedicated as we onboard later.

Ava (PM): thanks. I'll draft schedule: canary start = (kernel merged + staging GPUs) + 2 days; GA target = canary + 10 days buffer. publishing timeline in #product by EOD.

Ava (PM): attaching recommended canary policy (for alignment):
```yaml
rollout:
  canary: 5%
  ramp: 10% per day
  metric: p95_latency
  threshold: 250ms
  fallback: previous-stable
```

Priya (Security): small note — add audit logging enabled for canary and a retention tag.

Ravi (Eng): +1 to audit logs. we'll add a quick flag to enable in staging.

deploy-bot: Canary job queued for staging cluster (job-98765). will report status here.

deploy-bot: Canary job started — running smoke tests.

Marta (Runtime): will watch the perf run logs and share a short report when done.

Ava (PM): great. if anyone's blocked, DM me. otherwise i'll post the schedule and owner RACI in the ticket. :thumbsup:
